title: eriobotrya deflexa var. buisanensis
intro: Eriobotrya deflexa var. buisanensis, commonly known as Buisan plum or Buisan persimmon, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae. It is a deciduous shrub or small tree that is native to the Philippines and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Eriobotrya deflexa var. buisanensis include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
